title: FBI-UAP-D003, Digital Rendering, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
what_is_it: A digital artistic rendering (image) depicting a 2022 unresolved UAP incident near Colorado Springs, Colorado, based on a first-hand narrative from a companion FBI report.
interpretation_warnings: The extracted text is almost entirely garbled OCR output — no legible sentences could be recovered from the PDF body, so nearly all facts come from metadata and the CSV description rather than the document itself.
This is an artistic rendering, not primary evidence such as a photograph, sensor data, or direct witness statement.
The rendering derives from a single companion report (FBI-UAP-D002); without that source document, the accuracy of the depiction cannot be assessed.
The case is classified as 'unresolved' — no determination was made about the nature of the reported phenomena.
